## "The Substrate (slim)"

Opens the shared contribution substrate the next two rungs (v2.19 pull, v2.20 push) build on: a public, runtime-agnostic contract naming the existing 9-section `SKILL.md` shape as the one format both directions target, plus the integrity plumbing — a per-workspace install manifest (`cowork.install.json`) and a CI-computed `sha256` registry column — a future pull step needs to trust what it reads. Ships the format and the plumbing only; the pull flow itself arrives at v2.19.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md#2180---2026-07-22](https://github.com/jmlozano1990/Cowork-Starter-Kit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#2180---2026-07-22)
